title: Spotify second-quarter 2026 financial results
excerpt: Q2 revenue was EUR 4.777 billion, gross margin 33.4%, operating income EUR 655 million and free cash flow EUR 797 million.
summary: The SEC-filed issuer update supports current user, subscriber, revenue, margin, free-cash-flow, liquidity, product and Q3 guidance evidence for the quarter ended 2026-06-30.
